# netbox_tunnels (Data Source)

Lists NetBox tunnel objects (`/api/vpn/tunnels/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_tunnels" "all" {}

data "netbox_tunnels" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "status", value = "active" },
  ]
  limit = 50
}

output "tunnels_names" {
  value = data.netbox_tunnels.filtered.items[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/vpn/tunnels/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) All custom field values of the object as a JSON object (`jsondecode(...)`); selection values are unwrapped to the choice value and related objects to their ID.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `encapsulation` (String) Encapsulation. Valid values: `ipsec-transport`, `ipsec-tunnel`, `ip-ip`, `gre`, `wireguard`, `openvpn`, `l2tp`, `pptp`.
- `group_id` (Number) ID of the Tunnel Group (`netbox_tunnel_group`).
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `ipsec_profile_id` (Number) ID of the Ipsec Profile (`netbox_ipsec_profile`).
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `planned`, `active`, `disabled`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `terminations_count` (Number) Terminations Count.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) Tunnel Id. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.
